## Bindplane — Microsoft Sentinel ASIM Health

Verify that Bindplane is delivering records into Microsoft Sentinel ASIM tables. Every panel below scopes to rows tagged by the Bindplane `asim_standardization` processor (`AdditionalFields.Attribution.bindplane_source == "bindplane"`), so the figures reflect only Bindplane-routed data even when other sources write to the same tables.

Requires the Bindplane OpenTelemetry collector with the `asim_standardization` processor v1.8.0 or later.

content.query:
union withsource=TableName
    ASimAuthenticationEventLogs,
    ASimNetworkSessionLogs,
    ASimDnsActivityLogs,
    ASimProcessEventLogs,
    ASimFileEventLogs,
    ASimAuditEventLogs,
    ASimWebSessionLogs,
    ASimDhcpEventLogs,
    ASimRegistryEventLogs,
    ASimUserManagementActivityLogs
| where tostring(AdditionalFields.Attribution.bindplane_source) == "bindplane"
| summarize Events = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), TableName
| render timechart
content.title: Event volume by ASIM table

content.query:
union
    ASimAuthenticationEventLogs,
    ASimNetworkSessionLogs,
    ASimDnsActivityLogs,
    ASimProcessEventLogs,
    ASimFileEventLogs,
    ASimAuditEventLogs,
    ASimWebSessionLogs,
    ASimDhcpEventLogs,
    ASimRegistryEventLogs,
    ASimUserManagementActivityLogs
| where tostring(AdditionalFields.Attribution.bindplane_source) == "bindplane"
| summarize Events = count() by EventVendor, EventProduct
| sort by Events desc
content.title: Distribution by EventVendor / EventProduct

content.query:
union withsource=TableName
    ASimAuthenticationEventLogs,
    ASimNetworkSessionLogs,
    ASimDnsActivityLogs,
    ASimProcessEventLogs,
    ASimFileEventLogs,
    ASimAuditEventLogs,
    ASimWebSessionLogs,
    ASimDhcpEventLogs,
    ASimRegistryEventLogs,
    ASimUserManagementActivityLogs
| where tostring(AdditionalFields.Attribution.bindplane_source) == "bindplane"
| summarize LastReceived = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count() by TableName
| extend MinutesSinceLast = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastReceived)
| project TableName, LastReceived, MinutesSinceLast, Events
| sort by MinutesSinceLast asc
content.title: Last data received per ASIM table (Bindplane-routed)
